read: 2026-10-11, by eye from the cached layout image
comment: Perfboard layout with a colour wiring diagram, the bare underside and an etched PCB; read from the populated board. Two DPDT toggles (TR1, TR2) wire to the board edge pads; three 1mH inductors on the board. The legend calls the output pot Level, the board pads Volume.
uncertain: 22nF under the Fuzz pot pads (rows C-D): printed 22nF on both the board and the wiring diagram but drawn as a round electrolytic can, so it may be meant as 22uF
rows: one drawn as a round can under the Fuzz pads
pads labelled Volume on the board
